definitions.explanation: A person who performs to entertain others. In modern Japanese, most commonly refers to comedians (お笑い芸人), but can also refer to other types of performers such as street performers, variety show talents, or traditional entertainers.

examples.japanese: あの{芸人|げいにん}は{面白|おもしろ}い。
{若手|わかて}{芸人|げいにん}がテレビで{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: Young comedians are active on television.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{芸人|げいにん}を{目指|めざ}して{大阪|おおさか}から{上京|じょうきょう}した。
examples.english: He came up to Tokyo from Osaka aspiring to become a comedian.

notes:
USAGE:
In modern usage, {芸人|げいにん} most often means a comedian, especially an お{笑|わら}い{芸人|げいにん} (comedy entertainer). Japanese comedy culture, centered in Osaka and Tokyo, is a major part of the TV entertainment industry. Many {芸人|げいにん} work in pairs (コンビ) performing manzai or conte.

The word can also refer more broadly to any performer or entertainer, including {大道|だいどう}{芸人|げいにん} (street performer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{笑|わら}い{芸人|げいにん}: comedian
- {若手|わかて}{芸人|げいにん}: young/up-and-coming comedian
- {大道|だいどう}{芸人|げいにん}: street performer
- {売|う}れっ{子|こ}{芸人|げいにん}: popular comedian
- {芸人|げいにん}{魂|だましい}: entertainer's spirit
